properties.statement:
MEASURED, fix program item 9 (the sweep) and item 10, 2026-10-03.

THE SWEEP. Every defect_overtaken_by_change gap on main 293f9577 (61) and on PR #662's head ba1454be (16 more) was judged against the code by five agents and re-checked: 20 FIXED, 1 WITHDRAWN, 13 PARTLY, 43 NOT FIXED (/home/ajs7/.claude/jobs/fa666a94/tmp/sweep/sweep.json, outside the repo).

① THE NAMED REPAIR WAS THE FIX ONCE IN 77 (the settle-rule record, #636). Re-measured with the v0.77.0 release binary on main 73cf37b: 62 questions; a question whose repairs include the real fix: 1; FIXED rows whose fix the detector can see at all: 1 of 20.

② WHY IT COULD NOT SEE THE OTHER 19, per fixing change: 10 carry no detected_at (an undated change is never later); 7 are dated the same day as the defect (detect.rs counted only day > valid_from); 2 are typed new_feature (repairs only). Seven of the 20 fixes were ALREADY JOINED to their defect — the defect CAUSES the change (3), the change MITIGATES it (1), or a repair's CHANGED set names the defect itself (3) — and the detector read none of those edges. None drew INVALIDATES, so each fixed defect kept reading open: the stale open defect this detector exists to catch, arriving through its own blind spot.

③ NOISE. #662's change chg:every-gate-runs-the-binary-it-is-told-2026-10-03 (typed defect_fix, CHANGED 21 records, 17 of them gate scripts that REALIZE a capability) re-asked 24 questions and re-keyed 23 already on main, so answers given on main would not carry over. Across the 77, 195 of the 363 near-but-wrong candidates were repairs already recorded as the fix of ANOTHER finding (INVALIDATES/MITIGATES one, or one CAUSES them), against 1 of the 8 near fixes; and a hub file (art:service realizes 19 capabilities, art:detect 21) put every broad repair on every defect of every capability it realizes.

BOUNDS: one design (reflow2's own), the sweep's verdicts read code at named lines and re-ran cheap checks; nothing after v0.77.0 was run for the sweep. Four of the 20 fixes are joined to nothing and touched neither the defect's subject nor a file realizing it, so no structural rule can reach them.
